My reasoning: Factory farming involves tens of billions of animals enduring extreme suffering in confined, inhumane conditions. Welfare reform interventions (such as corporate cage-free commitments, legislative reforms, and awareness campaigns) can affect millions of animals at very low marginal cost. While the evidence base has more uncertainty compared to bednet distribution, the sheer scale of suffering involved means that even modest, uncertain improvements can translate to an enormous reduction in total suffering. A $100 micro-grant directed here has the potential to improve the welfare of a very large number of sentient beings.
